title: DataFreak
tagline: I created Dao for  Znosis, Morp. Resell  old  Item marketplace for NEON.  Data storage to store  the details of corporates  employees for IPC and One marketplace for Filecoin
description:
The description for the Dao project:

Gnosis: I used Particle AA for making the smart  account for this DAO
XdaiDao allows you to manage investment clubs, and to spread access to participate in investment funds to anyone, decentralized, agile, and without bureaucracy.Implementing a comprehensive on-chain governance system allows DataDAO members to create and vote on proposals, covering aspects such as member management, dataset storage and distribution, and token distribution. This ensures a democratic and transparent decision-making process within the DAO.

Morph : I deployed the Dao application on Morph and Neon for the future usecase as these chains are new so tried the AA  with the help  of Particle network Devrel mentor but can't built from scratch. The project description is:


NEON:  Created the full stack NFT re selling DAPP 

IPC: I created the  employee datawarehouse to store  all the info like employe pos, address, name and some basics information. 
By using IPC I managed to scale my application, Less gas expensive and ofcourse  due to subnet  the insertion deletion of the data becomes very simple and   gas friendly. 
The use case is:

The Sal-dApp provides an efficient platform for organizational administrators to effectively oversee and manage their employees' salaries by adding them as users and securely storing their information on IPFS/Filecoin network. The platform enables the administrator to process payments conveniently and seamlessly on both IPC and CALIBRRATION blockchain networks.


FILECOIN: I used lotus, venus as  the node provider, Lighthouse for the dataset storage. 
All the RASS, PODSI, DEAL STATUS, RENEW, REPAIR , CID shown in the project.

The description of the application is:
It is a marketplace where users can list their old items, and anyone can buy and resell them at a new price. After providing a review of a particular item, the user will receive an NFT as well.
